name: appdyno
stderr:
usage: appdyno <command> [flags]; appdyno <command> --help for its flags

commands:
  mcp [--device S] [--app A] [--allow-devices RE] [--allow-apps a,b] [--allow-urls RE] [--allow-data-loss virtual|all] [--allow-power virtual|all] [--allow-write dir]... [--allow-build] [--toolsets core,device,apps,evidence,network,perf] [--no-home] [--silent] [--takeover] [--share] [--animations on|off] [--measurements dir] [--trace-limit-gb N] [--flight-seconds N] [--full-urls] [--no-install-consent] [--accept-install-warnings] [--no-fetch] [--http 127.0.0.1:PORT]
                   the MCP server over stdio; with --http, on this Mac's loopback behind a token; --toolsets lists only those groups of tools, all of them when it is left out
  install [--yes] [--dry-run] [--remove]
                   add this server to the MCP clients on this Mac, or take it out
  update [--check] move to the latest release, verified before anything changes; --check changes nothing
  path [--remove]  from the app: put this appdyno on the PATH of every shell, or take it off
  devices          the connected devices
  version          which version this is
  test <dir or files> [--device S]... [--param NAME=value]... [--env-file F] [--tag T]... [--exclude-tag T]... [--shard i/n] [--artifacts dir] [--junit file] [--pr-body file] [--no-report] [--share] [--retries N [--fail-on-flaky]] [--update-baselines] [--measure [--iterations N] [--measurements dir]]
                   replay flows, one after another, on each device, and leave one verdict, one page, JUnit and a pull request text in the artifacts folder (--no-report: the record and JUnit alone); --shard 2/4 runs the second of four parts of the files, the same parts on every machine; --retries runs a failed file again and calls it flaky, which --fail-on-flaky fails the run for (exit 1); --update-baselines saves what visual steps compare with; --measure keeps each as a scenario, by step
  test merge <dir>... --out dir [--allow-mixed] [--junit file] [--pr-body file]
                   several runs' folders, as shards leave them, into one record, verdict, page, JUnit and pull request text; exit 1 when any part failed or a shard is missing, 2 when they cannot be one run
  test share <dir> [--zip file] [--with video] [--without video,logs,trees]
                   what a run's folder holds, to read before it is sent to anyone; --zip packs it, with the kinds --without names left out, and asks which when it holds a video
  test comment <dir> [--out file]
                   the pull request text again, from a run's record; no device
  doctor [--serial S]
                   what this machine and that device lack
  ios build [--no-fetch]
                   fetch or build the iOS runners now; --no-fetch builds the simulator's here and asks the network for nothing
  push setup apns|fcm [--forget]
                   a push service's credentials, which a person gives here and send_push uses; --forget deletes them
  tools install [adb] [--accept-license]
                   download the trace tools; adb: Google's platform-tools, under Google's terms
  bench --serial S [--n 50] [--out file] [--max-load N]
                   time reads, taps and typing on an Android device
  mirror [open] [--device S]... [--all [--watch]] [--max N] [--detach] [--quality auto|high|standard] [--codec h264|hevc] [--wifi] [--no-input] [--headless] [--pair] [--seconds N] [--takeover] [--record file.mp4] [--focus] [--allow-devices RE]
                   a live window on a device, driven by mouse and keyboard
  mirror close|status|stats
  pair [address code] [--device S] [--forget]
                   this Mac with a phone for Wi-Fi, once: an iPhone on its cable by --device, an Android phone by what it shows
  hub [--focus] [--allow-devices RE]
                   every device of this Mac in one window: start, stop, make one, open its window
  perf compare|baseline|budget [--app A] [--scenario S] [--device-class C] [--last N] [--replace] [--kind K] [--max N] [--min N] [--format text|json|junit] [--measurements dir]
                   the performance gate:
